values.value: Reconcile amendment delta variance on Quote {primaryRecordId}

1. Open amendment Quote {primaryRecordId}; expected delta was {quoteNetAmount}, Order sum landed at {orderTotal} ({direction} by {delta}). 2. List amendment Order(s): {orderIds}. Walk each line and confirm SBQQ__Existing__c flags are correct (FALSE only for new adds; TRUE for carried-over). 3. Mis-flagged Existing lines double-count on the Order — the Class E attribution path surfaces this if metadata indicates it. 4. Correct the SBQQ__Existing__c values on the source Quote, void the bad Order(s), and re-activate from the corrected amendment. 5. Add a Flow check on amendment activation that validates the delta matches before allowing the activation to proceed.
Amendment Existing flags corrected; activation re-run.
